settings.label: Tuner
settings.description: HDHomeRun tuners found on your network. D in the channel list opens the same picker.

settings.label: Backup Tuner
settings.description: Used when every tuner on Tuner is busy. Any other tuners follow; tuners that can't transcode always come last.

settings.label: Start In
settings.description: Which view opens first. From the channel list, > opens the guide; from the guide, C opens the channel list.

settings.label: Video Quality
settings.description: Shown for tuners with a hardware encoder (EXTEND). internet480 is 704x480, which matches a 480i CRT.

settings.label: Rescan Guide Data
settings.description: Starts a guide scan in the background. The first takes about 90 minutes; later ones are shorter.
